description: `View`, `Text`, `Image`, `ScrollView`, `FlatList`, `Pressable`, `TextInput`: React components that map to native views.
Style objects with camelCase properties, Flexbox (column by default) and unitless density-independent numbers. No cascade.
JavaScript Interface: a C++ layer that lets JS hold references to and call native objects directly.
The New Architecture renderer, supporting concurrent React features and synchronous layout.
Native modules loaded lazily and invoked through JSI, with types generated by Codegen.
